cases.name: ebox-remount-handles-empty-growing-and-shrinking-content
cases.purpose: Whole publication exactly replaces arbitrary old content across zero, empty, growing and shrinking row counts.

cases.name: ebox-remount-repairs-foreign-rows-and-retired-newline-properties

cases.name: ebox-remount-widens-and-resets-all-displaying-windows
cases.purpose: Mounting into a narrowed populated buffer still owns its whole text and starts point and every displaying window at the top.

cases.name: ebox-next-publication-repairs-foreign-text-and-properties
cases.purpose: After initial and incremental publication, foreign text and property edits in a subsequently changed row are repaired from the retained tree.

cases.name: ebox-restyle-preserves-characters-and-interior-markers
cases.purpose: Restyling adjacent parts updates their faces without changing buffer characters or moving native markers inside unchanged text.

cases.name: ebox-text-update-preserves-common-prefix-and-suffix-markers
cases.purpose: Growing and shrinking a local text value preserves native markers in its common prefix and suffix and keeps neighboring content.

cases.name: ebox-property-update-keeps-native-display-and-keymap-identity
cases.purpose: Property updates retain separate adjacent native displays, publish the replacement keymap by identity and remove retired input properties.

cases.name: ebox-remounted-subtree-restores-absolute-descendants
cases.purpose: Moving a retained tree into and out of a wrapper preserves its absolute descendants, native positions and subsequent child-list updates.

cases.name: ebox-mount-observer-reports-first-flush-and-validates-before-replace
cases.purpose: Mount-time observation reports the first and subsequent writes, while invalid observer options preserve an existing mount.

cases.name: ebox-backdrop-filter-keeps-overlay-input-and-blocks-underlay
cases.purpose: Filtered overlays retain their native keymap, hover, help and hit ownership over borrowed background pixels without click-through.

cases.name: ebox-focus-reaches-a-stop-scrolled-beneath-a-fixed-region
cases.purpose: A tab stop scrolled out of a scroller stays focusable although its layout line lies under an unrelated overlay; focus reveals it.

cases.name: ebox-rounded-frame-paints-only-its-outer-horizontal-edges
cases.purpose: Horizontal border paint stays on the outer top and bottom edges rather than leaking into shared blank cells.

cases.name: ebox-rounded-frame-preserves-content-geometry-and-activation
cases.purpose: Changing frame radius preserves labels, geometry and keyboard activation; unmount detaches subsequent updates.

cases.name: ebox-rounded-frame-never-removes-corner-glyphs
cases.purpose: Unpadded corners keep native glyphs intact, including cuts through a wide glyph.

cases.name: ebox-rounded-frame-keeps-nonuniform-borders-and-header-content
cases.purpose: A rounded panel retains header and body content and fixed geometry when unequal borders require square fallback.

cases.name: ebox-composition-occlusion-keeps-native-image-fragments
cases.purpose: Repeated partial occlusion retains the exposed parts of native image runs and raised image slices instead of blanking complete rows.

cases.name: ebox-composition-moving-overflow-keeps-canvas-and-neighbors
cases.purpose: Moving and resizing overflowing windows clips text and image rows without shifting neighbors; retained output matches fresh paint.

cases.name: ebox-composition-narrow-stack-keeps-padding-and-border
cases.purpose: A stacked child wider than its parent cannot displace the parent's padding and border.

cases.name: ebox-hidden-node-releases-replaced-callbacks
cases.purpose: A live hidden node releases callbacks removed from its public authored properties.

cases.name: ebox-detached-output-owns-callbacks-only-while-retained
cases.purpose: Rendered help remains usable while retained and releases callback resources after disposal.

cases.name: ebox-disposed-buffer-releases-rendered-callbacks
cases.purpose: Unmounting and killing a buffer releases resources captured by rendered callbacks.

cases.name: ebox-image-identical-preparation-reuses-a-screenful-of-images
cases.purpose: A preparation stays cached while more distinct images than the old clear-all threshold are prepared.

cases.name: ebox-image-cache-stays-bounded-and-usable-under-churn
cases.purpose: Preparing many distinct images keeps the most recent preparations reusable.

cases.name: ebox-image-placeholder-preparation-reports-size-and-content
cases.purpose: Placeholder image preparation reports size and returns deterministic character content.

cases.name: ebox-image-text-converter-result-is-renderable-image-node
cases.purpose: Text converters produce prepared image content renderable through an image node.

cases.name: ebox-node-set-image-repaints-mounted-image-node
cases.purpose: Changing an image node repaints the mounted buffer to the new prepared content.

cases.name: ebox-node-set-props-repaints-a-same-sized-image-with-other-pixels
cases.purpose: A different, already laid out preparation of the same size replaces the shown image instead of comparing equal.

cases.name: ebox-image-in-a-wider-box-paints-the-box-background-beside-it
cases.purpose: An image narrower than its stretched box leaves no unpainted gap beside it.

cases.name: ebox-image-slice-cut-at-a-box-edge-keeps-its-visible-part
cases.purpose: An image row slice cut at a box edge shows its visible part instead of a blank.

cases.name: ebox-image-prepare-rejects-invalid-protocol-inputs
cases.purpose: Image preparation rejects invalid sizes, adapters and sources.

cases.name: ebox-file-read-form-accepts-exactly-one-expression
cases.purpose: Ebox file form reading accepts one expression and rejects empty or extra input.

cases.name: ebox-file-evaluate-form-returns-renderable-dsl
cases.purpose: Evaluated file forms return renderable inert DSL data.

cases.name: ebox-file-evaluate-buffer-reads-current-buffer-source
cases.purpose: Buffer evaluation reads and evaluates the current buffer source through the file API.

cases.name: ebox-keymap-create-installs-activation-bindings
cases.purpose: Public keymap creation installs activation bindings and ebox-activate invokes them.

cases.name: ebox-help-create-runs-business-function-in-hovered-buffer
cases.purpose: Help adapters run the business function in the hovered mounted buffer.

cases.name: ebox-interaction-properties-cover-rendered-text
cases.purpose: Help, pointer, keymap and hover style capabilities become native text properties.

cases.name: ebox-clipped-overlay-keeps-interaction-on-blank-rows
cases.purpose: A clipped interactive overlay keeps its keymap and pointer on blank rows and cut padding.

cases.name: ebox-focus-first-next-previous-and-cycle-update-focused-node
cases.purpose: Focus navigation updates the public focused node in document order with cycling.

cases.name: ebox-keyboard-activation-belongs-to-focused-ancestor
cases.purpose: A keyboard activation typed while point rests on a clickable descendant of the focused node activates the focused node.

cases.name: ebox-tab-order-finishes-a-side-region-before-the-next
cases.purpose: Tab order follows the tree, so a sidebar's stops all precede the region beside it even when they share screen rows.

cases.name: ebox-focus-within-stays-inside-container
cases.purpose: Focus-within navigation remains inside the requested container.

cases.name: ebox-focus-change-functions-report-each-move
cases.purpose: Explicit focus and Tab navigation report each change of focused node, including clearing, and not a repeated focus of the same node.

cases.name: ebox-focus-group-is-one-tab-stop-roved-by-arrows
cases.purpose: A focus group is one Tab stop entered at its selected or remembered member; arrows rove inside it, leave at its edges and Home reaches its first member.

cases.name: ebox-focus-direction-moves-to-nearest-stop-and-enters-grids
cases.purpose: Directional focus moves to the nearest stop in each direction and moves geometrically inside a grid group.

cases.name: ebox-focus-direction-honours-a-root-boundary
cases.purpose: A ROOT argument limits directional candidates to its subtree and reports the boundary with nil.

cases.name: ebox-modal-focus-scope-confines-navigation
cases.purpose: A visible modal focus scope confines Tab, arrow navigation and the listed focus stops until it is removed.

cases.name: ebox-focus-reveals-node-inside-scroller
cases.purpose: Focusing a node scrolls its Ebox scroller so the node and point show.

cases.name: ebox-focus-navigation-resumes-near-a-removed-node
cases.purpose: Navigation after the focused node disappears continues from its last position.

cases.name: ebox-focus-shows-hover-content
cases.purpose: Keyboard focus shows a node's hover content and restores it when focus leaves.

cases.name: ebox-buffer-mode-arrows-move-focus-and-scroll-at-the-end
cases.purpose: Mounted buffers bind arrows, C-n/C-p and Home/End to directional focus navigation.

cases.name: ebox-overlays-cover-hits-positions-and-focus-in-paint-order
cases.purpose: Overlapping overlays hit in paint order, and boxes covered by them have no position and refuse focus.

cases.name: ebox-buffer-mode-keeps-paren-matching-off-painted-text
cases.purpose: A mounted buffer turns off paren matching so it never tints layout cells, and leaving the mode restores the user's setting.

cases.name: ebox-buffer-mode-shows-no-region-on-the-canvas
cases.purpose: Setting the mark in a mounted canvas leaves no active region to paint, while the same buffer outside the mode keeps native region behavior.

cases.name: ebox-node-at-resolves-padding-cells-to-their-box
cases.purpose: A padding or indent cell resolves to the box that owns it rather than the root.

cases.name: ebox-node-at-resolves-scrolled-padding-cells-to-their-box
cases.purpose: Inside a scroll container, a child's padding cell resolves to that child rather than the scroller.

cases.name: ebox-descendants-inherit-or-block-native-feedback
cases.purpose: Descendants inherit an ancestor's help, pointer and hover feedback unless they set it to nil.

cases.name: ebox-hover-paints-over-a-nodes-own-background
cases.purpose: Hover paint covers a node's own background too; suppressing hover for a selected item is application policy, not an engine guess.

cases.purpose: Hover feedback joins every row of a multirow element into one mouse-face run instead of highlighting only the pointer's row.

cases.purpose: Pointer motion repaints only the pointed element across all its rows, preserves neighbours and text, follows a publication and restores paint on leave.

cases.name: ebox-hover-paints-the-padded-box-through-the-node-style
cases.purpose: Hover paint covers the node's padding rows through its own computed paint, and leaving restores the resting paint everywhere.

cases.name: ebox-hover-rests-at-an-explicit-nil-blocker
cases.purpose: Pointer hover over an explicit nil blocker leaves the element resting, and moving to a sibling paints the ancestor's fill again.

cases.name: ebox-hover-keeps-a-single-row-element-within-its-cells
cases.purpose: Hover feedback never bleeds past an element's last row into the rest of the screen row.

cases.name: ebox-render-carries-hover-across-rendered-rows
cases.purpose: Rendered output carries hover feedback across rows exactly like a mounted buffer.

cases.name: ebox-hidden-node-paints-no-interaction-feedback
cases.purpose: A hidden element keeps its layout slot but paints no hover, pointer, help or activation feedback.

cases.name: ebox-unanchored-overlay-has-no-position-or-focus
cases.purpose: An overlay whose anchor is missing paints nothing, has no position and refuses focus.

cases.purpose: Node bounds span a box's first painted row by default and all of its painted rows on request.

cases.purpose: A node's bounds start at its first cell even where its own positioned descendant paints over it.

cases.name: ebox-node-bounds-keep-hidden-flow-slots
cases.purpose: A visibility-hidden box in flow reports its blank slot as bounds, while a hidden overlay has none.

cases.name: ebox-focus-derived-state-matches-selector-and-styles
cases.purpose: Focused nodes expose :focus selectors and focus-dependent styles.

cases.name: ebox-activate-noerror-returns-nil-without-command
cases.purpose: Activation with noerror returns nil when no command is present.

cases.name: ebox-next-and-previous-interaction-move-between-keymap-owners
cases.purpose: Interaction navigation moves point between rendered keymap owners.

cases.name: ebox-render-text-and-box-forms
cases.purpose: Strings, text forms and fixed-width boxes render their observable text through the public renderer.

cases.name: ebox-render-row-and-column-flow
cases.purpose: Row and column layout order children with public gaps and line flow.

cases.name: ebox-render-wraps-aligns-and-measures-cjk
cases.purpose: Text wrapping, alignment and CJK measurement produce the documented visible lines.

cases.name: ebox-render-keeps-punctuation-off-line-edges
cases.purpose: Soft wraps keep closing punctuation off line starts and opening punctuation off line ends.

cases.name: ebox-render-paints-face-and-display-spaces
cases.purpose: Paint styles and pixel padding produce public face and display text properties.

cases.name: ebox-render-keeps-neighbours-sharing-one-display
cases.purpose: Adjacent characters sharing one display value keep every glyph on the line.

cases.name: ebox-render-border-uses-display-spaces-and-border-faces
cases.purpose: Borders render as display spaces carrying visible border face attributes.

cases.name: ebox-render-side-borders-paint-their-width
cases.purpose: Left and right borders paint their declared pixel width; top and bottom borders are limited to 1px.

cases.purpose: Flex wrapping and gaps place items at observable public geometries.

cases.purpose: Whole-line flex shrinkage removes complete rows from the first items instead of scattering gaps.

cases.name: ebox-render-relative-flow-paints-above-lower-overlays

cases.name: ebox-render-grid-places-items-in-tracks
cases.purpose: Grid tracks and placements expose expected public node geometries.

cases.name: ebox-render-stretched-heights-fill-definite-areas
cases.purpose: A stretched height fills its grid area and stays definite for stretched descendants.

cases.name: ebox-render-visibility-hidden-preserves-layout-space
cases.purpose: Hidden boxes suppress ink while preserving layout space in the rendered buffer.

cases.name: ebox-backdrop-filter-keeps-text-and-dims-colors

cases.name: ebox-backdrop-filter-keeps-image-content-visible

cases.purpose: Prepared raster images dim without reopening their source, preserve geometry and insets, reuse composites, and restore exactly.

cases.purpose: Image filtering respects identity brightness, nested overlays, palette changes and live source replacement.

cases.name: ebox-backdrop-filter-partial-paint-preserves-source-and-input
cases.purpose: Partial overlay updates and repeated dim/identity filters preserve the source paint and restore native input after removal.

cases.name: ebox-backdrop-filter-keeps-covered-cells-out-of-flow-hit

cases.purpose: Scrolling past a scroller's end never scrolls a window that already shows the whole buffer.

cases.name: ebox-page-scroll-commands-accept-explicit-line-counts
cases.purpose: Page scroll commands accept explicit line counts and update visible content.

cases.purpose: Growing and shrinking text in fixed-height flex containers preserves following content and matches a fresh render.

cases.name: ebox-fixed-flex-native-multiline-edit-preserves-following-content
cases.purpose: Multiline native input, clearing and undo preserve independently updated content below the editing container.

cases.name: ebox-input-session-relayouts-during-editing
cases.purpose: A viewport change lays out at once during a session and editing continues.

cases.purpose: Input sessions reject non-text nodes, invalid keymaps and concurrent sessions; ending or unmounting releases them.

cases.name: ebox-call-with-input-returns-reader-value-and-closes-session
cases.purpose: call-with-input returns the reader value, focuses its target and closes the active session.

cases.name: ebox-selector-query-finds-type-id-class-attribute-and-state
cases.purpose: Selector queries find nodes by type, id, class, attribute and author state.

cases.name: ebox-node-set-states-updates-selector-matches-and-styles
cases.purpose: Changing public selector states updates matching and cascaded styles.

cases.name: ebox-inline-ecss-cascades-to-descendants
cases.purpose: Inline ECSS rules cascade to matching descendants and produce observable faces.

cases.name: ebox-style-scope-membership-controls-rule-visibility
cases.purpose: Shared style scope membership controls which scoped rules affect a node.

cases.name: ebox-style-scope-with-rules-preserves-membership-identity
cases.purpose: Replacing scope rules preserves membership identity while changing visible style.

cases.name: ebox-style-scope-create-rejects-invalid-rules-and-origins
cases.purpose: Invalid style scope selectors, declarations and origins are rejected.

cases.name: ebox-inheritance-and-local-overrides-affect-faces
cases.purpose: Inherited text color and local overrides appear in rendered face properties.

cases.name: ebox-disabled-property-derives-disabled-selector-state
cases.purpose: Disabled interaction state is observable through public selectors.

cases.purpose: Mounting exposes root, buffer and viewport state and viewport changes relayout the tree.

cases.name: ebox-node-put-and-set-props-restyle-visible-content
cases.purpose: Property mutation updates visible faces and remains equivalent to a fresh render.

cases.name: ebox-scope-root-rule-change-restyles-members
cases.purpose: Replacing a scope root's rule snapshot restyles nested members to the new rules.

cases.name: ebox-parent-restyle-updates-inheriting-descendants
cases.purpose: Restyling a parent updates descendants that inherit its values, including explicit inherit declarations.

cases.name: ebox-node-insert-remove-move-and-replace-children-update-order
cases.purpose: Structural node mutations update child order and mounted text through public APIs.

cases.name: ebox-shrunk-flex-item-update-keeps-following-siblings

cases.purpose: After-flush hooks run with the mounted buffer already updated.
